tools.name: validate_api
tools.description: Lint an OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, Arazzo, or JSON Schema document against the curated best-of-breed ruleset (Spectral) and return the findings. Pass your own `ruleset` to run rules you own instead of the catalog — which is what you should do before gating on anything.

tools.name: api_coverage
tools.description: Measure how much of an API description your governance actually inspects — coverage by section, each rule's reach, and the rules that match nothing. Like test coverage, one altitude up.

tools.name: reconcile_waivers
tools.description: Reconcile a waivers file against lint output: suppress sanctioned violations and surface the expired, stale, and expiring ones. Returns the effective failing set a build should gate on.

tools.name: governance_report
tools.description: Turn Spectral findings into a self-contained HTML governance report — severity summary, grouped by rule, framed toward progress.

tools.name: verify_certificate
tools.description: Re-verify a governance certificate against the API it attests to. If the API drifted or the certificate was forged, verification fails.

tools.name: classify_api_fields
tools.description: Inventory the PII, secret, and sensitive fields an OpenAPI exposes, across parameters and request/response schemas. Run this before exposing an API to agents.

tools.name: diff_api_versions
tools.description: Compare two OpenAPI versions and classify every change as breaking, non-breaking, or an addition — at path, operation, parameter, request-body, and response granularity.

tools.name: api_scorecard
tools.description: Score an API's maturity 0-100 with a letter grade across design, governance coverage, documentation, and (from an apis.json) discoverability, agent-readiness, and operations. Pass your own `ruleset` — a score against rules you never adopted means little.

tools.name: govern_estate
tools.description: PRO — Run the core governance checks across a WHOLE SET of internal APIs and roll them up: per-API score/grade/errors/PII, plus estate aggregates (avg score, grade distribution, APIs with PII/secrets) and a worst-first punch-list of what to fix. Pass `apis` ([{id, document}]) and your own `ruleset`. detail:true adds per-API dimensions.

tools.name: deprecation_posture
tools.description: Report every deprecated operation and whether it actually announces a sunset. The ones that go quiet are the ones that break consumers.

tools.name: validate_onboarding
tools.description: Validate an API Onboarding Descriptor (AID) against the api-commons schema and report which optional sections it fills in.

tools.name: certify_api
tools.description: Issue a tamper-evident governance certificate attesting an API passed a named ruleset at a profile threshold. A SHA-256 fingerprint lets anyone re-verify it.

tools.name: export_agent_rules
tools.description: Turn a governance ruleset into agent-native guidance — an AGENTS.md block, a system-prompt set, a per-rule remediation pack, and a digest — so agents follow the rules while authoring, not after linting.

tools.name: audit_pipeline
tools.description: Score a repository's Spectral CI setup against an 8-point maturity rubric and return a prioritized punch-list. Pass a public `repo` ("owner/name") or `files`.

tools.name: forge_mcp_tools
tools.description: From an OpenAPI, forge an MCP server design, per-operation tools, Agent Skills, an enriched OpenAPI, a server.json, and apis.json properties.

tools.name: gate_agent_context
tools.description: Choose which operations and fields an API exposes to agents and emit a governed Tyk OpenAPI, an MCP tool manifest, and a Spectral ruleset with PII and secret checks.

tools.name: apply_overlay
tools.description: Apply an OpenAPI Overlay to a document and report what each action matched. Use it for deprecation and migration choreography without forking the contract.

tools.name: mock_payloads
tools.description: Generate an example request and success-response payload for every operation from its schema.

tools.name: code_snippets
tools.description: Generate runnable curl, JavaScript, and Python samples for every operation, with path params filled in and a realistic body.

tools.name: score_reusability
tools.description: Score how reusable a set of APIs is and detect duplication across them — the anti-sprawl view of an estate.

tools.name: map_api_experience
tools.description: Map each REST operation to its MCP tool and Agent Skill — the API -> MCP -> Agent-Skill chain — from an APIs.json, with a free/paid coverage scorecard and a flow map.

tools.name: generate_agent_descriptor
tools.description: Generate an API's llms.txt and an AGENTS.md consumption contract — base URL, auth, the operation table, deprecated operations to avoid, and usage rules.
